description: Recent activity in one or more communities hosted on this PDS, newest first. What another PDS calls, with service-auth for the viewer, to build that viewer's timeline.

main.description: Merged activity of the listed communities, newest first. Requires authentication: a session, an OAuth token, or a service-auth token (lxm net.openfederation.activity.listCommunityActivity) signed by the viewer's DID. A public community is listed for any authenticated caller; a private one only for its members, its owner and PDS admins. Join requests are listed only to the community's owner and PDS admins. A community that cannot be listed (not hosted here, not active, private and the caller is not a member, taken down) is returned in `unavailable`, all with the same answer.

community.description: Community DIDs, up to 25. Repeat the parameter for each.

cursor.description: From a previous page of this method or of getUserTimeline: the two share one cursor format.
Pass back to fetch the next page. Absent on the last page.

unavailable.description: Requested communities that were not listed.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: No community, more than 25, or a cursor this server did not hand out.

entry.description: One thing that happened in a community, built from records and indexes the community already has. Nothing is written to produce it.

id.description: Unique across communities: the record's at-uri, or for an entry with no record a namespaced key. The tie-breaker in the sort order.

kind.description: What happened. Clients should skip kinds they do not know.

actor.description: Who did it: the member who joined or asked to, the proposer, the thread's author. Absent for an event, which the community publishes.

uri.description: The record, when there is one. A join request has none.

createdAt.description: When the community's PDS recorded it, UTC with microseconds. The sort key.

summary.description: A few fields to render a line without fetching the record. Which are present depends on kind.

startsAt.description: event.created: when the event starts, as the record gives it.

targetCollection.description: proposal.created: the collection the proposal would change.

status.description: proposal.created: the proposal's status now. event.created: the event's status, if set.
